ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Huge Things
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Huge plants and huge animals that behave like their size.
The engine gives every plant and every pawn one cell, however big it is drawn. A mushroom twenty cells across can only be clicked on the cell it grows from, pawns walk straight through its stem, and walls get built inside it. A beast drawn the size of a house can only be selected by clicking near its middle.
Huge Things fixes that for anything that opts in:
- A huge PLANT gets a solid trunk. Its stem blocks a small patch of cells (sized per species, and grown into as the plant grows), so pawns walk around it and nothing can be built inside it. You still walk under its cap, the way you walk under a tree. Clicking anywhere on the trunk selects the plant. Cutting, harvesting, burning and save/load all work as usual; when the plant dies or is cut down, the trunk goes with it. - A huge ANIMAL (or any pawn) gets a selection hitbox the size of its drawn body, so clicking anywhere on it selects it.
This is the engine only. Nothing is huge until a mod opts it in, by giving a plant the RM_HugePlantExtension or a pawn's race the RM_HugePawnExtension modExtension. Every mechanic has a Mod Settings toggle.
